about: A forecast provider supplies a site with its forecasts (the site says so). Every edge: the page that says so (`source`), when we read it (`read_utc`), whether the phrases we looked for were on it (`state`), a short quote. Stamped by tools/meteorology-read.mjs.

expect: BBC Weather in association with MeteoGroup
edges.note: The page's footer carried the line "BBC Weather in association with MeteoGroup" and a link to MeteoGroup at every read up to 09:25 UTC on 12 November; at 12:33 UTC on 12 November, read twice, the footer lists only the World Meteorological Organization and the Met Office and the line is gone. What we read, not why: the page gives no reason, and it no longer says who supplies its forecast.
